description: Local UI Server Function input: start an approved UPDATE write after the confirmation dialog (Task 31 design 3 'how the target is chosen', 10; T31h-2). scenarioId is the UPDATE scenario, expectedRevision is the scenario revision the screen read, and expectedTargetRecordId is the planned target record the screen showed (a usable record id); the server issues the execution grant with it (the issue chooses the target again and rejects a different one) and starts the update job at once. No property holds a credential, a cookie, a token or an input value.
